Atribución organizativa
relations.reading: An anti-circularity design would separate evidence of technical contribution from evidence of organizational recognition.

relations.title: Valor descubierto
relations.reading: Diamond Inside opportunities can be described more precisely by separating technical contribution, current recognition and the route through which value might actually be realized.

relations.title: Poda segura de búsqueda
relations.reading: A safe search-pruning rule does not justify treating low usage or recognition as evidence that a business capability is dispensable.

relations.title: Atribución organizativa
relations.reading: A capability-loss study should include useful survivors, genuine redundancies and documented losses rather than selecting only successful informal adaptations.

relations.title: Carga de coordinación
relations.reading: The attribution ratchet sharpens one incentive mechanism behind architectural complexity: blame remains attached to the source while credit is captured downstream.

relations.title: Procedencia auditable
relations.reading: Lineage establishes dependency, while contribution still requires independently evidenced consequences, substitution conditions and a reliable scoring protocol.

relations.title: Atribución organizativa
relations.reading: Independent dependency and attribution records provide a concrete comparison for the distinction between found flow and declared representation.

relations.title: Coste de claridad
relations.reading: The cost of obtaining clarity and the contribution of the capability being examined require separate measures and independent interpretations.

relations.title: Traducción de captura a arquitectura
relations.reading: The information model can preserve separate dependency and attribution channels, allowing the Attribution Gap protocol to test their divergence without building it into the data.

relations.title: Autoridad de decisión
relations.reading: Compressed accountability should not become concentrated blame without matching authority or visible contribution.

relations.title: Transmisión de juicio tácito
relations.reading: Tacit-knowledge concentration can inform a contribution estimate when tied to observable exception handling and replacement conditions rather than reputation.

relations.title: Madurez definida y autoevaluada
relations.reading: The stated Level 3 position is a methodological self-assessment, which should remain separate from certification and independently measured intervention performance.

relations.title: Atribución organizativa
relations.reading: Work-based talent recognition illustrates why visible credentials and demonstrated capability should be assessed separately, while retaining a different unit of analysis from application-level attribution.

relations.title: Observabilidad del proceso
relations.reading: The independent occupancy channel illustrates the measurement discipline behind separating operational evidence from strategically asserted claims, while retaining each instrument's error model.

relations.title: Migración y capitalización de capacidad
relations.reading: A cross-border follow-up should establish whether the same capability was retained, transferred, duplicated or lost before applying an attribution-gap explanation.

relations.title: Activación entre tipos de frontera
relations.reading: Cross-frontier activation can also run from field constraints to research questions, provided later formalization is kept separate from validation of the original cases.

relations.title: Fallo de composición
relations.reading: A public incident account can motivate a collaboration challenge, provided the technical question is rebuilt from primary evidence and evaluated against a stated baseline.

relations.title: Estado de una afirmación
relations.reading: The mathematical reading route helps define a reviewable object: a conditional result, its source assumptions and the separate implementation question.

relations.title: Estado de una afirmación
relations.reading: The quantitative review line and the assessment proposal should be read as a scoped evaluation route, with participation and acceptance distinguished from demonstrated results.

relations.title: Estado de una afirmación
relations.reading: The component verification record is useful technical evidence when its same-author scope and unresolved independent-validation obligations remain attached.

relations.title: Estado de una afirmación
relations.reading: A collaboration challenge can preserve the history of findings while distinguishing a corrected implementation defect from an unresolved comparative research claim.

relations.title: Procedencia auditable
relations.reading: A source reference, a computational use and an attested review are different evidence states; each historical claim should name what was actually observed.

relations.title: Adquisición de evidencia falible y emparejada
relations.reading: An audited-Q claim becomes testable when audit observations, fallibility, scope and cost are explicit, rather than supplied as a favorable Boolean flag.
